ORDINANCE



        BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO :

       SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3,
       Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on
       Map No. 16-D and Map No. 18-0 in the area bound by:

               East 71 st Street; South Woodlawn Avenue; a line 100 feet north of and parallel to the
              alley next south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; a line 110 feet east of and parallel to
              South Woodlawn Avenue; East 71 st Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South
              Woodlawn Avenue and extended north where no alley exists; the alley next north of and
              parallel to East 69th Street; the west right-of-way line of the Illinois Central Railroad; East
              73rd Street; South Woodlawn Avenue; East 74th Street; the alley next east of and parallel
              to South Greenwood Avenue; a line 121 .9 feet north of and parallel to Easy 74 t h Street;
              South Greenwood Avenue; the alley next northeast of and parallel to South South
              Chicago Avenue; East 73 rd Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South University
              Avenue; East 72nd Street; South Woodlawn Avenue; a line 37 feet north of and parallel
              to East 72nd Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Woodlawn Avenue; East
              72nd Street; South Dobson Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East 73 rd
              Street; South Ellis Avenue; the alley next northeast of and parallel to South South
              Chicago Avenue; South Ingleside Avenue; the north right-of-way line of the alley next
              south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South
              Ingleside Avenue; a line 23.5 feet north of and parallel to the alley next south of and
              parallel to East 71 st Street; South Drexel Avenue; and the alley next northeast of and
              parallel to South South Chicago Avenue;

       to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

       SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                                     Desmon C. Yancy
                                                                     Alderman, 5th Ward
